lines.W2.3: Eastar(TM) Renew GN001-50 copolyester is a clear, amorphous material. Because of its clarity, toughness and good melt strength at processing temperatures, it is useful in a variety of processing techniques.
lines.W2.4: Eastman Solus™ 9142 performance additive is a cellulose ester that is designed to perform well in demanding applications. The unique attributes of this product enable clear non-yellowing films, good UV stability, minimized cratering and strong inter-coat adhesion. With a low Tg (glass transition temperature) and low M(n), it is compatible with many other coating components and numerous cross-linking resins, offers low solution viscosity in a wide range of solvents & solvent combinations, and improves flow & thermal reflow. </br>
lines.W2.5: Solus™ 7250, Food Contact is a cellulose ester based additive masterbatch suitable for blending with polybutylene succinate (PBS) resin for extrusion coating on paper.
lines.W2.6: Tritan™ Renew copolyester EX401-50, specifically developed for the Infant Care market, is an amorphous copolyester with excellent appearance and clarity.
lines.W2.7: Eastman Solus™ Renew 5175-75 performance additive is designed to provide high-performance in building and construction coatings. This cellulose ester enables excellent surface hardness while achieving wide solubility and compatibility with many other resins.

lines.W2.10: Eastman Solus™ 5350 performance additive is designed to provide high-performance in building and construction coatings. This cellulose ester enables coatings to exhibit UV stability & non-yellowing, excellent inter-coat adhesion, clear films, and superior avoidance of surface defects via flow & leveling properties. Production benefits include reduced surface tack, improved thermal reflow, broad compatibility with curing resins & other coating components, low solution viscosity and solubility in a wide range of solvents & solvent combinations. When dissolved in appropriate solvents, a clear colorless solution is produced. Solus™ 5350 is supplied in pellet form, offering formulation convenience, ease of handling and maximum formulating flexibility. </br></br></br> Eastman Solus™ 5350 is based on cellulose, one of the most abundant natural renewable resources.</br></br></br> For applications that require food contact compliance, please discuss requirements with your Eastman technical expert.

Eastman Solus™ 1225 performance additive is designed to deliver on the high performance expectations required of ink and metal packaging formulations. This cellulose-based additive enables formulations with good resistance to UV discoloration, excellent hardness and anti-blocking properties in support of high production speeds. Solus™ 1225 is well adapted for use in printing inks and overprint varnishes as a result of its wide solubility in relevant solvents, strong compatibility with other ink resins, desirable resistance to grease and oil, low odor properties, and high melting point. When Solus™ 1225 is dissolved in appropriate solvents a clear, colorless solution is produced. Supplied as a dry free-flowing powder, this product is often used in combination with other Solus™ products to optimize the formulation viscosity. </br></br> </br></br> Eastman Solus™ 1225 is based on cellulose, one of Earth's most abundant natural renewable resources, with an approximate calculated bio-content value of 45%. </br></br> </br></br> For applications that require food contact compliance, please refer to Eastman Solus™ 1225, food contact and discuss requirements with your Eastman technical representative.

lines.W4.1: We collaborate with customers in various markets, including agriculture, construction, medical, packaging, personal care, textiles and transportation.
lines.W4.2: The world needs the solutions we provide, and we are committed to developing groundbreaking solutions for a wide variety of industries.
lines.W4.3: Driven by more than 100 years of innovation, we collaborate with customers around the world across a wide range of industries. For decades, our innovations have improved the quality of life for consumers. Our materials go into everything from can coatings for the food you eat to the fibers in your clothing and home textiles. Our resins make housewares dishwasher safe, tough, and stylish and high-performance medical devices more durable. We provide organic acids that replace antibiotics in animal feed. And our polymers are in low-emissions coatings for homes and cars.
lines.W4.4: We’re ushering in a new era of innovation while helping our partners solve society’s greatest sustainability challenges. Our innovative films enable electric vehicles to be lighter weight for greater range and are used for next-generation technology like head-up displays for windshields to improve safety. We’re also a world leader at developing fiber from sustainably sourced wood pulp to make sustainable clothing, biobased plastic for eyewear, and compostable food packaging that won’t harm the planet.
lines.W4.5: These are just some examples of the industries where Eastman materials are being used. Explore the markets where we are making an impact.
lines.W4.6: Eastman brands make life better for people in countless ways. We collaborate with customers to meet critical consumer needs across multiple industries.
lines.W4.7: We offer an extensive range of products. Our advanced materials, additives and functional products, specialty chemicals, and fibers are found in items people use every day around the world.
lines.W5.2: Our intermediates, solvents, catalysts and neutralizing agents help farmers produce more while maintaining compliance.
lines.W5.3: Today's farmers and feed producers face growing pressure to produce more, comply with evolving regulations and navigate increasingly complex conditions. Eastman understands these challenges, and we support agriculture every day with a comprehensive portfolio that spans every stage.
lines.W5.4: We provide crop protection solutions, including plant growth regulators, seed treatment products and soil care solutions that strengthen crops from the ground up. For agrochemical companies and formulators, we supply intermediates for active ingredient production and ingredients used in formulations. In animal nutrition, we offer feed additives that promote gut health and support feed preservation and hygiene.
